title: Support SLA Continuation
request: Continue the existing support queue from the prior phase. Add SLA-aware escalation while preserving the small in-memory API: tickets may include customerTier and openedAt, breached tickets must be detected from tier-specific SLA windows, and summarizeQueue must surface breach counts, tier breakdown, escalationStatus, and nextAction.
context: Phase 1 already shipped add, assign, resolve, list, and summary behavior. The prior handoff is available in docs/phase-1-support.md.
SLA windows are enterprise 4 hours, business 24 hours, and standard 72 hours. Missing customerTier defaults to standard; missing openedAt defaults to the current clock.
Customer notes include future ideas such as AI replies, macros, and queue-worker alerts. This phase is only about deterministic SLA breach detection and escalation summary fields.
Do not add persistence, HTTP routing, queue workers, or dependency changes. Keep structured validation errors and the injectable now() clock.
successCriteria: Existing support queue tests continue to pass.
addTicket accepts optional customerTier and openedAt, with standard and the current clock as defaults.
Invalid customer tiers and openedAt values throw structured validation errors.
listBreachedTickets returns unresolved tickets past the tier-specific SLA window.
summarizeQueue preserves existing summary fields and adds breachedCount, breachedByTier, escalationStatus, and nextAction.
